one_line: Fourth–fifth century Vakataka king of Vidarbha, consolidator of Pravarapura and patron of early Shaiva institutions.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, medium height, lean but well-toned royal build
appearance.face: Oval face with a calm, thoughtful gaze, medium brown complexion, straight nose, neatly groomed short mustache, slight stubble at the chin, faint worry-lines at the brow; default expression is composed and analytical, softening into a small, reassuring half-smile.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair gathered into a short, tidy topknot at the back crown, sides smoothed and tucked behind the ears; a narrow gold headband with a small central lotus motif holds the hair, with a short red tilaka mark on the forehead just beneath it.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate early Gupta–Vakataka royal attire: an ivory-white, knee-length cotton tunic with half sleeves and a subtle woven border, worn over a tightly wrapped, ankle-length off-white dhoti with a golden-yellow edge; across his torso a deep maroon silk uttariya (shawl) with fine gold thread borders drapes from the left shoulder under the right arm, neatly folded; he wears a plain yet elegant gold torque necklace, medium-width gold armlets on both upper arms engraved with simple floral motifs, slim gold bangles on his wrists and modest gold stud earrings; his feet are in brown leather sandals with simple straps; overall textiles are fine but not overly ornate, emphasizing dignified restraint.
appearance.signature: A rolled copperplate charter held in his left hand, its ends capped with small bronze knobs and tied at the center with a crimson cord and seal, while his right hand lightly rests on the hilt of a sheathed straight iron sword with a simple bronze crossguard at his waist.

ref_desc: Pravarasena II is a medium-build, mid-30s king with a medium brown oval face, short topknot under a gold headband, ivory tunic and off-white dhoti with golden-yellow edge, deep maroon shawl, simple gold jewellery, brown sandals, and a rolled copperplate charter with sheathed sword.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Pravarasena II, a dignified early 5th-century Vakataka king: a medium-height, lean but toned man in his mid-30s with a medium brown oval face, calm thoughtful eyes, straight nose, neat short mustache and slight chin stubble, wearing thick black hair gathered into a short tidy topknot at the back of his head, held by a narrow gold headband with a small central lotus motif and a short red tilaka on his forehead. Dress him in an ivory-white, knee-length cotton tunic with half sleeves and a subtle woven border, over a tightly wrapped ankle-length off-white dhoti with a golden-yellow edge, and drape a deep maroon silk uttariya (shawl) with fine gold borders from his left shoulder under his right arm, folded neatly. Adorn him with a plain gold torque necklace, medium-width gold armlets with simple floral engraving on both upper arms, slim gold bangles, modest gold stud earrings, and brown leather sandals with simple straps. At his waist, show a sheathed straight iron sword with a simple bronze crossguard that his right hand rests on lightly, while his left hand firmly holds a rolled copperplate charter tied at the center with a crimson cord and seal, emphasizing the charter as his signature prop; use a palette dominated by ivory white, off-white, deep maroon, golden yellow, and brown leather, and present front, side, and back views to clearly show hair, headband, clothing layers, jewellery, and weapons consistently.
